_: Never raised (AGENTS.md). lines: counted as `scripts/ceiling.mjs` says, every shipped .rs file under some row. A row split from another is its lines at the split plus 15% (`core/tactics` 5 more for `tactics::engage`, `sim/src/duel` 15 more for its real side's hooks, `sim/src/duel/real` its 138 lines), and the row it left its remaining lines plus the headroom it had. comments: the most percent of a src directory's own lines that are `//` comments, by the directory, else `_default`. counts: the most a per-tick count the bot reports in its observe segment (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.3) may stand at, over a scenario's whole run: `floodsMost` the floods one warm tick ran, `coldFloodsPerColony` those a cold tick (the first, or one after a reset) or one of the three after it ran over the colonies the cold tick held, `atlasMissRate` the percent of warm kept-flood lookups that flooded (live floods, round what moves, apart), `threatLookupsMost` the tiles a Hunt scored in one tick (nine a body of the largest set, eight). `npm run scenario` holds every scenario to them but `floodsMost`, which binds only a scenario naming it.
